sourcedFrom: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) (2021 (copyright line))
cleanIntro: A CSX strips like a 1911 in one respect that surprises people: it is a hammer-fired, aluminium-framed, thumb-safety pistol, and the safety goes UP to SAFE before anything else happens. ⛔ Two details are S&W's own and are what this gun gets wrong when rushed: the takedown pin is drifted out to the LEFT with a punch, not thumbed out, and the slide comes back only about 1/4 INCH to line the notch up — further and the pin will not clear. ⚠ Lubrication is by count: eight points, one drop each, and S&W says over-oiling is what collects powder residue and stops the pistol working.

steps.title: Safety UP to SAFE before anything else
steps.action: Muzzle in a safe direction, fingers off the trigger and outside the guard, and press the manual safety lever fully up into the SAFE position.
steps.prose: S&W puts the safety first in its own strip sequence, before the magazine even comes out. Fully up — a partly engaged thumb safety on a hammer gun is worse than none, because it feels engaged.
steps.quote: Press the manual safety lever fully up into the SAFE position
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — FIELD STRIPPING/DISASSEMBLY, printed pp.33-36
steps.warn: ALWAYS ENSURE THAT THE FIREARM IS UNLOADED BEFORE INSPECTING, DISASSEMBLING OR ASSEMBLING.

steps.title: Magazine out, then the chamber — in that order
steps.action: Press the magazine release and take the magazine out of the pistol. Only then go to the chamber.
steps.prose: The order is the whole safety argument on a semi-auto: rack first and the magazine feeds another round in behind it. Magazine, then chamber, every time.
steps.quote: Press the magazine release, and remove the magazine from the pistol
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — FIELD STRIPPING/DISASSEMBLY, printed pp.33-36

steps.title: Rack briskly and look — the CSX has a chamber flag in the box
steps.action: With the muzzle safe and the pistol held upright, grasp the serrated sides of the slide from the rear and draw it briskly fully rearward to throw out anything in the chamber. Then look into the chamber.
steps.prose: Briskly is the manual's word and it matters: a slow pull can leave a round balanced on the extractor instead of clearing it. Upright so the round falls out rather than back in.
steps.quote: With the barrel still pointing in a safe direction, and with your finger off the trigger and outside the trigger guard, grasp the serrated sides of the slide from the rear with the thumb and fingers (FIGURE 62) while holding the firearm in an upright position, briskly draw the slide fully rearward in order to extract any cartridge from the barrel chamber and clear it from the pistol.
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — FIELD STRIPPING/DISASSEMBLY, printed pp.33-36
steps.warn: WEAR SAFETY GLASSES EVERY TIME YOU ASSEMBLE OR DISASSEMBLE YOUR FIREARM.

steps.title: Lock the slide open, confirm, then let it close
steps.action: Pull the slide fully to the rear and press up on the slide stop while letting the slide ease forward, so it locks open. Look through the ejection port and magazine well one more time, then let the slide close.
steps.prose: This is the last look you get with the pistol assembled. Do it here, not after the pin is out.
steps.quote: Pull the slide fully to the rear, press upward on the slide stop while letting the slide move slightly forward thereby locking the slide open
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — FIELD STRIPPING/DISASSEMBLY, printed pp.33-36

steps.title: ⛔ Back about 1/4 INCH — and hold it there
steps.action: Draw the slide back roughly a quarter of an inch and HOLD it, so the takedown notch in the slide lines up with the raised hump on the takedown pin.
steps.prose: ⛔ This is the step the CSX punishes. A quarter inch — not the full stroke, not locked open. If the pin will not move, the notch is not aligned, and forcing it marks the frame. Get the alignment right and the pin walks out under light pressure.
steps.quote: Align this "hump" with opening in slide and frame
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — FIELD STRIPPING/DISASSEMBLY, printed pp.33-36

steps.title: Drift the takedown pin out to the LEFT
steps.action: From the right side of the pistol, use a small drift or punch to press the takedown pin out to the left.
steps.prose: Directional, and worth reading twice: you push from the opposite side and it exits left. A punch, not a screwdriver tip — the pin head is shallow and a blade slips off it into the frame.
steps.quote: From the opposite side of the pistol, use a small drift or punch to press the takedown pin out of the pistol to the left
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — FIELD STRIPPING/DISASSEMBLY, printed pp.33-36

steps.title: Slide forward off the frame — catch the recoil spring
steps.action: Grasp the slide from the top and pull it forward off the frame, keeping hold of the recoil spring and guide rod assembly as it comes.
steps.prose: The spring is short, stiff and captive-ish rather than captive. Fingers over the front of the slide as it leaves the frame and it stays where you can see it.
steps.quote: Grasp the slide from the top as shown and remove the slide from the frame by pulling it forward while being careful to retain the recoil spring and guide rod assembly
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — FIELD STRIPPING/DISASSEMBLY, printed pp.33-36

steps.title: Recoil spring out, then the barrel
steps.action: Lift the recoil spring assembly out of the slide, then lift the barrel out. That is the field strip: frame, slide, barrel, recoil spring assembly, magazine and the takedown pin.
steps.prose: Note which way round the recoil spring assembly sat — the end toward the muzzle is the smaller one, and it goes back that way.
steps.aside: Remove the barrel from the slide assembly
steps.quote: Remove the recoil spring from the slide assembly
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — FIELD STRIPPING/DISASSEMBLY, printed pp.33-36

steps.title: Bore and chamber with a brass brush, finish dry
steps.action: Brush the bore and chamber with a properly fitted BRASS brush dipped in gun solvent to take the heavy residue out, then run a dry cotton patch through to carry the residue and the solvent back out.
steps.prose: Finish dry. Solvent left standing in a bore is not protection, it is a slow etch, and the oil comes afterwards as its own step.
steps.quote: Remove excessive firing residue from the bore and chamber using a properly fitted brass brush dipped in gun cleaning solvent. Finish the bore cleaning process by running a dry cotton cloth patch through the bore to remove residue and solvent.
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — CLEANING AND MAINTENANCE, printed pp.44-46

steps.title: Slide rails, breech face, feed ramp, frame rails
steps.action: Work the carbon off the breech face and around the extractor, out of the slide rails inside the slide, off the barrel hood and locking surfaces, and out of the frame rails. Then wipe the exterior with a non-abrasive cloth.
steps.prose: The CSX has an aluminium frame with steel rail inserts; the carbon collects where the steel and the aluminium meet. Non-abrasive on the outside — the finish is thin over aluminium and a scouring pad will find that out.
steps.aside: After cleaning, lightly coat the metal parts, internal and external with a high quality gun oil.
steps.quote: Clean the exterior of the firearm using a non-abrasive cleaning cloth.
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — CLEANING AND MAINTENANCE, printed pp.44-46

steps.title: ⛔ Eight points, one drop each — count them
steps.action: Lubricate at the eight points S&W identifies, a single drop at each, and stop there.
steps.prose: ⛔ This is a specification, not a suggestion, and the failure it prevents is a real one: excess oil on a small carry pistol collects unburned powder into a paste that binds the rails. If oil is running or pooling anywhere, there is too much.
steps.quote: There are eight (8) lubrication points where a single drop of firearm lubricant should be applied. This will ensure proper lubrication. Care should be taken not to over-lubricate. Excess lubricant can collect quantities of unburned powder and carbon residue, which could interfere with proper functioning of the pistol
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — LUBRICATION, printed p.36

steps.title: ⛔ What must never touch this pistol
steps.action: No ammoniated or strong alkaline solvents. No prolonged solvent immersion and no prolonged ultrasonic cleaning.
steps.prose: ⛔ S&W names the chemistry by class rather than by brand, which is the useful form: copper solvents with ammonia will attack the finish, and a long ultrasonic bath strips lubricant out of places you cannot re-oil without stripping the gun further than this manual allows.
steps.aside: You should avoid prolonged solvent immersion and prolonged ultrasonic cleaning of your firearm.
steps.quote: Ammoniated solvents or other strong alkaline solvents, should not be used on any Smith & Wesson firearm.
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — CLEANING AND MAINTENANCE, printed pp.44-46

steps.title: Field strip complete — and this is S&W's ceiling
steps.action: Six pieces on the bench and nothing else comes apart. S&W's own instruction is that an owner does not go past the field-strip and inspection procedures in this book.
steps.prose: ⛔ There is no owner-level firing pin, extractor or sear procedure published for the CSX. The DEEP CLEAN below is the magazine — which S&W does publish — and nothing more.
steps.quote: Never disassemble your firearm beyond the instructions in the Field Stripping and Inspection sections of this manual.
steps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — CLEANING AND MAINTENANCE, printed pp.44-46

deepSteps.title: ⛔ The magazine spring is the hazard, not the magazine
deepSteps.action: Before touching the floor plate: safety glasses on, and plan to keep a thumb over the floor plate the whole time. The spring is compressed inside the assembled magazine.
deepSteps.prose: ⛔ A 12-round magazine in a pistol this small has a strong spring in a short tube. It launches the follower and the floor plate catch across the room, and those are the two parts you cannot easily replace.
deepSteps.quote: THE MAGAZINE SPRING IS UNDER PRESSURE IN THE ASSEMBLED MAGAZINE. WHEN DISASSEMBLING OR ASSEMBLING THE MAGAZINE, CONTROL THE SPRING AND OTHER PARTS OF THE MAGAZINE SO THEY DO NOT FLY OUT AND CAUSE INJURY.
deepSteps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — MAGAZINE, printed pp.42-43

deepSteps.title: Depress the catch through the floor plate hole
deepSteps.action: Use a small drift or punch through the hole in the floor plate to press the floor plate catch down into the tube.
deepSteps.prose: The hole is there for exactly this. Keep the punch square — angling it rounds the catch off and then the floor plate no longer locks.
deepSteps.quote: Using a small tool like a drift or punch, depress floor plate catch through the hole in the floor plate
deepSteps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — MAGAZINE, printed pp.42-43

deepSteps.title: Slide the floor plate off while holding the catch down
deepSteps.action: With the catch still held down, slide the floor plate forward off the tube, keeping your thumb over the opening against spring pressure.
deepSteps.prose: This is the moment. The plate goes forward, not down, and the thumb stays put until the spring is under control.
deepSteps.quote: Slide floor plate forward off of the tube while holding floor plate catch in the tube (FIGURES 98 and 99) against spring pressure.
deepSteps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — MAGAZINE, printed pp.42-43

deepSteps.title: Catch, spring and follower out — and note the orientation
deepSteps.action: Let the floor plate catch, the spring and the follower come out of the bottom of the tube, controlling them as they go. Note which way round each one sat before it leaves.
deepSteps.prose: ⛔ The follower and the catch are both orientation-sensitive and both will go back in wrong without complaining until the magazine fails to feed. Lay them out in the order they came out.
deepSteps.quote: Remove floor plate catch and spring and follower out through bottom of tube
deepSteps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — MAGAZINE, printed pp.42-43

deepSteps.title: Clean the tube dry — and NOT the way you clean the gun
deepSteps.action: Wipe the inside of the tube, the follower and the spring with a dry cloth or a lightly solvent-damped patch, and leave them DRY. Do not oil the inside of a magazine.
deepSteps.prose: ⛔ Oil in a magazine tube is a dirt magnet and it migrates onto cartridge primers. This is the one part of the pistol that gets cleaned and not lubricated.
deepSteps.quote: Whenever your firearm has been exposed to sand, dust, extreme humidity, water or other adverse conditions, it must be cleaned and lubricated.
deepSteps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — CLEANING AND MAINTENANCE, printed pp.44-46

deepSteps.title: Back together, in exactly the orientation it came apart
deepSteps.action: Spring, follower and floor plate catch go back front-to-back in precisely the orientation they were removed in; then hold the catch down and slide the floor plate onto the base of the tube until the catch engages it.
deepSteps.prose: Then test it: push on the floor plate as if trying to slide it off. If it moves, the catch is not through its hole and the magazine will shed its floor plate on the first reload.
deepSteps.aside: Verify that the floor plate is locked in place by exerting some pressure on the floor plate - as if trying to slide it off the tube.
deepSteps.quote: Install magazine spring and follower and floor plate catch front to back into the tube in exactly the same orientation as they were in when they were first removed during disassembly.
deepSteps.cite: Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols — Safety & Instruction Manual For Smith & Wesson CSX Pistols (no form code printed on the cover) — MAGAZINE, printed pp.42-43

cleaning.name: BARREL
tasks: Brass brush and solvent through bore and chamber
Dry cotton patch to carry residue and solvent out
Carbon off the hood and the locking surfaces

cleaning.name: SLIDE
tasks: Breech face and around the extractor
Internal slide rails and the recoil spring channel
Wipe, do not scour — the finish is thin

cleaning.name: FRAME
tasks: Frame rails and the area under the barrel seat
⛔ Eight lubrication points, ONE drop each
Nothing internal comes out — S&W's ceiling

cleaning.name: MAGAZINE
tasks: Wipe the tube, follower and spring DRY
Check the floor plate is locked by pushing on it

reassembly: Barrel back into the slide, muzzle flush with the end of the slide and the barrel lug turned up away from the ejection port.
Recoil spring assembly in with the SMALLER end toward the muzzle, into the slide guide housing; the larger end goes against the barrel lug. Check it is centred.
Slide onto the frame rails, then align the takedown notch and press the takedown pin in until it clicks.
Let the slide run fully forward, put the thumb safety down to FIRE, then with your thumb firmly on the hammer pull the trigger and lower the hammer to rest.
Replace the empty magazine and draw the slide fully rearward — the slide stop should rise and hold the slide open.
fncheck: Unloaded and proven, muzzle safe, safety glasses if the magazine came apart. With an EMPTY magazine in, draw the slide fully back — the slide stop should rise and lock it open; drop it and the slide should run home. Thumb safety up: the slide should be locked and the trigger dead. Safety down to FIRE and dry-fire once with your thumb controlling the hammer. Then check the takedown pin is fully seated and flush — a proud takedown pin is the tell that the notch was not aligned when it went in, and it will work loose under recoil.
